method: Deterministic overlap-add of joint-free 32x32 scanned ceramic interiors, broad source normals removed; authored low-frequency firing/glaze and wear fields. No scene photograph is read.
glazeField: Spatial inference for a partly sealed ceramic surface; not measured target BRDF.
metalFields: Project-authored periodic multiscale casting pores and roughness, seed7149149.
normalConvention: OpenGL, tangent +U across tile, +V along run. Low-frequency source tile molding removed so the true tile mesh supplies the curve.
